description:
Land the host-side GPU dispatcher in `gf2-algebra::gpu` that routes batch-permanent workloads to the F_3 / F_5 / F_7 HIP kernels (T23-T25), with feature-gated compilation under `hip`.

## Background

Users call `gf2_algebra::gpu::permanent_batch_bipedal3(&matrices)` and similar. The dispatcher checks the `hip` feature is on, validates the device exists, copies inputs to device memory, launches the appropriate kernel, copies outputs back. CPU fallback is `permanent_bipedal3` from T13, used when `hip` is not enabled at compile time or the device is missing at runtime.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] [hard] `gf2_algebra::gpu::permanent_batch_bipedal3`, `permanent_batch_bipedal5`, `permanent_batch_bipedal7` exist behind the `hip` feature.
- [ ] [hard] Without `hip`, the entry points either return a `cfg`-disabled compile error or fall back to per-matrix CPU iteration; document the chosen behaviour in the function docs.
- [ ] [hard] On a gfx1030 host with `hip` enabled, end-to-end batch test: 1000 random matrices for $n=24$ produce results bit-identical to the CPU path.
- [ ] [hard] Tests gated `#[cfg(feature = "hip")]` and `#[ignore = "external: gfx1030 device required"]`.
- [ ] [hard] `cargo build -p gf2-algebra --release --features hip` succeeds on a ROCm host.
title: Host-side GPU dispatcher in gf2-algebra
